additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414249-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] BC4 Modbus error CRM:01251001306
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
We have checked the logs for 24/03/25 &  Modbus connection interrupted in IMD_BC4 appeared 3 time.
2025-03-24T09:19:44.575445+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/c4c03790570d[640]: PLC-Error-Flag 'IMD_BC4' changed from true - (' Modbus connection interrupted') to true - (' Iso status not valid')
2025-03-24T07:59:59.367900+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/c4c03790570d[640]: PLC-Error-Flag 'IMD_BC4' changed from false - ('IMD ok') to true - (' Modbus connection interrupted')
2025-03-24T06:41:27.691033+00:00 [FW060103G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/c4c03790570d[640]: PLC-Error-Flag 'IMD_BC4' changed from false - ('IMD ok') to true - (' Modbus connection interrupted')
But “ Modbus connection interrupted” didn't appeared during charging session. All the session in DC4 was successful with successful cable check.
it appeared in ideal state & got rectified by it self.
Please note:
Since the safety relevant function of the bender is enforced through hardwired relay contacts to the PLC, charger safety is not affected. The main function of the Modbus comm is to ensure correct voltage during cable check of every new charging session. Active charging sessions will not stop due to iso modbus comm loss
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414249-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] BC4 Modbus error CRM:01251001306
additional_info.body:
Hi, thanks for the information.
But the outlet will go unavailable when the bender loses the Modbus connection. So during the connection interruptions costumer cant use the outlet.
Should we consider changing the Bender unit or what do you think causes these interruptions?
/Simen

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414249-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170001094] BC4 Modbus error CRM:01251001306
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
Could you please check the tightness of Brown & white cable which is connected in A & B terminal in Bender.
If tightness is ok but still fault is appearing , carry a spare IMD & replace it.
